svg.title: Change in driving times in Porto Alegre with congestion in the centre and with Avenida Ipiranga closed
svg.desc: Two maps of Porto Alegre covered by hexagons coloured by how much longer, on average, it takes to drive from each cell to all the others. On the left, cars move at half speed within 2 km of the centre (dashed circle): the centre itself loses most, and the cells whose trips cross it lose a little. On the right, Avenida Ipiranga, an east-west arterial along the Dilúvio creek, is closed to cars: the cells along it lose most.

g.text: How much longer, on average, the drive from each cell to all the others takes (blank: under half a
minute; free flow otherwise). Centre at half speed: +0.3 min over all pairs, and the health facilities
within 10 minutes' drive of the average resident fall from 35.5 to 32.3. Avenida Ipiranga closed:
Congestion and a closed avenue: what driving loses
